public_rationale: Oracle reported six buildings delivered two days after the post. That is important contrary context, but it does not establish that five or more were functional on September 8. Earlier construction updates also cannot establish the count on that day. The available records therefore do not settle the claim.
limitations: The earnings-call transcript is hosted by a third party.
Delivery and operation may mark different milestones.
A later count cannot be backdated without supporting records.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At most four of the eight buildings at the Stargate Abilene campus are functional.

statement.excerpt: Per sources with direct knowledge of the current progress of Stargate Abilene, the AI data center being built by Crusoe for Oracle to lease to OpenAI, there are at most four out of eight buildings functional at the Abilene campus, which started construction some time in 2024.

from_speaker: at most four out of eight buildings functional
our_interpretation: Functional means commissioned and capable of serving customer AI workloads, rather than merely structurally complete.
The scope is the original eight-building Oracle/OpenAI campus.
Current progress describes the status on September 8, 2026. This is a point-in-time construction observation, rather than a quarterly financial observation.
criteria.support_condition: Dated operational records establish that no more than four of the original eight buildings were functional on September 8, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated operational records establish that at least five of those buildings were functional on September 8, 2026.
